title: 第7章 新能力第8章 不速之客
slug: 从部落开始我有一本山海经
content_zh:
“天钧龙内丹？”
连师惊讶道。
在为了各族部落生存，先人将已知血兽划分为甲、乙、丙、丁、戊、己、庚、辛、壬、癸等十个等级，最后的癸级为一些食用后增加微薄气血的家畜动物，严格上来说算不上血兽，岩牛部落的圣塔白晶牛则是辛级血兽，连师等人从未见过丁级血兽，但是知道即使是天元部落的天元烈风鬼只是己级血兽。
岩蒙也知丁级血兽是什么概念，此时连连摆手道“这太贵重，蓝姑娘快收起来吧。”
兰姓少女没有看他，巡察四周，目光最终停留在年纪最小的阿皓身上。
不知为何感觉这个少年很是特殊，漆黑的双眸中有着她不曾见过的东西。
随手将手中天钧龙内丹一丢，不以为意道：“区区内丹，我赠与的东西从来都没有拿回来的先例。”
阿皓双手一接，暗暗吞下口水，强忍着心中吞噬的欲望，不知所措的看向岩蒙。
岩蒙看着女子言语间不经意的流露出的大家风范，看了看阿皓默默点头。
“那我们便收下了，天色不早，便不打扰姑娘休息。”
岩蒙说罢与屋中其余人纷纷离去。
戈子继续守在少女屋外，阿皓跟随着岩蒙与连师一同到了连师住所内。
这五年期间，阿皓基本是住在了连师后院中，早间阅读关于刻纹的各种记载书籍，午时后结束了其他药剂配比的学习外，便在平滑的石板上铺满细小砂砾，用手指粗细的树枝代做玄阳笔，开启精神力千万次练习刻画纹路，要求快而稳，除了纹路外，不得触碰多余的一粒砂砾。
晚间跟随连师冥想修习，前年隐隐感觉自己的精神力仿佛到达了瓶颈，不再提升，据连师说他已经走到刻纹师的门槛前了。
连师打量着手中羊眼大小的内丹，银白色的内丹上隐隐流转着金色条纹，连连赞叹：“没想到我大把年纪还能看到丁级血兽的内丹，这真是……”
岩蒙也是点头讶然道：“丁级天钧龙，如果有丁级血兽出现在克特巴帕平原上的话，没有一个部落能幸免于难。”
阿皓此时极力控制着自己的表情，金色小册已经犹如失控一般，冲击着阿皓头脑发晕，他觉得自己快疯了，甩了甩头询问道：“连师，内丹到底是什么，什么是精神力进阶。”
“首先对于刻纹师来说，精神力是唯一的武器，刻纹师化为天、地、玄、黄四等，黄阶刻纹师能刻纹叁纹之下的血纹，玄阶能刻纹陆纹以下，地阶则能刻纹九纹之下所有血纹，天阶刻纹师我却不知有何种威能，不过精神力每达到一定界限，进阶后便会增长寿元。”
连师神色像是回忆着什么。
“据说只有丁级之上的血兽头颅中会有内丹形成，服用可瞬间提升精神力，有些甚至可以帮助刻纹师精神力进阶一个大等阶。”

阿皓此时好奇问道：“那连师您是等阶啊？”
连师听后看向阿皓，笑吟吟的摸摸阿皓的头道：“我现在精神力是黄阶上级。”
“那连师把它吃了吧，如果”
阿皓强忍着头晕，笑道。
虽然知道自己那金色小册渴求着那内丹，但是连师是部落里年纪最为年长的人，如今部落里的人都是连师看着长大的，心中的那份尊敬无以言表。
且如果连师服用后，达到玄阶的话那会对部落有着极大的提升。
连师与岩蒙二人笑脸对视，都欣慰的看着眼前这部落里最年轻的一代，正是有了他们这样的孩子，部落才会有更多的明天。
连师摇头淡然道：“我已经活得够久了，尤其这几年，明显感觉到精神力在衰竭，就算服用着内丹，也维持不了几年，何必暴殄天物。”
岩蒙也是点头正色道：“我也赞成阿皓你服用，我们终是岩牛部落老一辈，未来是你们的，在近几十年中，只有你有成为刻纹师的顶级天赋，为了部落的延续，必须你来服用，我相信你会带着那帮小子能把岩牛部落带回，甚至超越曾经最鼎盛的时期。”
阿皓随即受惊道“族长！”
岩蒙的意思阿皓能听出来，这是有传位之意。
不由大为震惊，连连推辞：“族长，我还是个孩子，更何况还有塔子哥他们，听说塔子哥气血已经快到达贰纹战士的标准了，不久便可进行刻纹仪式了。”
content_en:
"Tianjun Long Neidan?"
The company commander said in surprise.
For the survival of various tribes, ancestors divided the known blood beasts into ten grades: A, B, C, D, Wu, Ji, Geng, Xin, Ren and Gui. The last Gui grade refers to some domestic animals that increase their meager Qi and blood after being eaten. Strictly speaking, it is not a blood beast. The Holy Tower White Crystal Bull of the Yanniu Tribe is a Xin-level blood beast. Lian Shi and others have never seen a D-level blood beast, but they know that even the Tianyuan Gale Ghost of the Tianyuan Tribe is only a level I blood beast.
Yan Meng also knew what a D-level blood beast was. At this time, he waved his hands and said, "This is too precious. Miss Lan, please put it away quickly."
The girl surnamed Lan did not look at him, but looked around, and her eyes finally landed on the youngest Ah Hao.
For some reason, she felt that this boy was very special. There was something in his dark eyes that she had never seen before.
He casually threw away the Tianjun Long Neidan in his hand and said nonchalantly: "It's just an inner elixir. There is no precedent for getting back the things I gave away."
Ah Hao took it with both hands, secretly swallowed his saliva, suppressed the devouring desire in his heart, and looked at Yan Meng at a loss.
Yan Meng looked at the woman's elegant demeanor and looked at Ah Hao, who nodded silently.
"Then we'll accept it. It's getting late, so we won't disturb the girl's rest."
After Yan Meng said this, he and the rest of the people in the room left one after another.
Gezi continued to guard outside the girl's house, and Ahao followed Yanmeng and Lianshi to Lianshi's residence.
During these five years, Ah Hao basically lived in the company's backyard, reading various books on carving in the morning, and finishing studying the ratio of other pharmaceuticals in the afternoon. Then he spread fine gravel on the smooth stone slab, and used branches as thick as his fingers to make Xuanyang pens. He used his mental power to practice carving the lines thousands of times. It was required to be fast and steady. Apart from the lines, no extra grain of gravel was allowed to be touched.
I practiced meditation with Master Lian in the evening. The year before last, I felt that my mental power had reached a bottleneck and would no longer improve. According to Master Lian, he had already reached the threshold of being an engraver.
The company master looked at the inner elixir the size of a sheep's eye in his hand. There were faint golden stripes on the silvery white inner elixir, and he repeatedly praised: "I didn't expect that I could still see the inner elixir of a D-level blood beast at my old age. This is really..."
Yan Meng also nodded and said in surprise: "D-level Tianjunlong, if a D-level blood beast appears on the Ketbapa plain, no tribe will be spared."
Ah Hao tried his best to control his expression at this time. The golden booklet seemed to be out of control, and it hit Ah Hao's head and made him dizzy. He felt that he was going crazy. He shook his head and asked: "Lian Shi, what is the inner alchemy and what is spiritual power advancement."
"First of all, for the engraver, mental power is the only weapon. The engraver is transformed into the four levels of heaven, earth, Xuan and Huang. The yellow-level engraver can engrave the blood patterns below the three lines, the Xuan-level can engrave the blood lines below the land lines, and the earth-level engraver can engrave all the blood lines below the nine lines. I don't know what kind of power the heaven-level engraver has, but every time the mental power reaches a certain limit, the lifespan will increase after advancing."
The company commander looked like he was remembering something.
"It is said that only blood beasts above level D will have inner elixirs formed in their skulls. Taking them can instantly increase their mental power. Some of them can even help the engraver's mental power advance to a higher level."
Ah Hao asked out of curiosity: "What rank are you, Company Master?"
After hearing this, the company commander looked at Ah Hao, smiled and touched Ah Hao's head and said, "My mental power is now at the upper level of Huang rank."
"Then the company commander should eat it, if"
Ah Hao suppressed his dizziness and smiled.
Although he knew that his golden booklet longed for the inner elixir, Lian Shi was the eldest person in the tribe. Now everyone in the tribe had grown up watching Lian Shi, and the respect in his heart was beyond words.
And if the company master reaches Xuan level after taking it, it will greatly improve the tribe.
Lian Shi and Yan Meng looked at each other with smiles, and they were both pleased to see the most powerful member of the tribe in front of them.The younger generation, it is with children like them that the tribe will have a better tomorrow.
Lian Shi shook his head and said calmly: "I have lived long enough, especially in the past few years, I have obviously felt that my mental power is declining. Even if I take the inner elixir, it will not last for a few years, so why waste my natural resources."
Yanmeng also nodded and said seriously: "I also agree with you, Ahao, to take it. We are the older generation of the Yanniu tribe after all, and the future belongs to you. In the past few decades, only you have the top talent to become an engraver. For the continuation of the tribe, you must take it. I believe that you and the gang of boys can bring the Yanniu tribe back to its peak period, and even surpass it."
Ah Hao was immediately frightened and said, "Clan leader!"
Ah Hao could hear what Yan Meng meant. It meant passing the throne.
He couldn't help being shocked and refused: "Clan leader, I am still a child, not to mention Brother Tazi and the others. I heard that Brother Tazi's energy and blood have almost reached the standard of a second-marked warrior, and he will be able to perform the tattooing ceremony soon."
